items.text: no wait for visibility before screenshot
items.reason: Every recipe waits for a heading or element to be visible (or uses a locator-scoped screenshot that auto-waits) before capturing.
The document repeatedly requires masking or freezing dynamic content and lists its absence as an anti-pattern.
Examples wait for page content to load before the screenshot and explicitly reject waitForTimeout.

items.text: no API stubbing for live data
items.reason: The frozen-data recipe stubs the API with page.route and route.fulfill before capture.
The document tells the reader to screenshot the component rather than the full page and reserves full-page only for layout tests.
Empty and error state tests stub the API per state to drive each render.

items.text: visual tests mixed with functional tests
items.reason: Visual specs are isolated via testMatch patterns and an @visual grep, not mixed with functional tests.
Each Playwright project sets an explicit viewport in the config.

items.text: no filtering of visual test files
items.reason: The config filters visual tests with testMatch and the CI job greps @visual.
The document requires reviewing expected/actual/diff images in show-report or the hosted UI.

items.text: committing baseline changes without PR review
items.reason: The baseline workflow requires PR reviewers to verify baseline images and calls unreviewed updates an anti-pattern.

items.text: choosing tool without considering Storybook status
items.reason: Tool selection explicitly asks whether Storybook is in the project before choosing Chromatic or alternatives.

items.text: Lost Pixel mentioned as current option
items.reason: Lost Pixel is listed under Avoid as an archived repo, not as a current option.
The document has a dedicated review and approval workflow section and a Done When item for it.
Baselines are platform-tagged and generated in the CI Docker image, never shared across platforms.
